say:2:1330369001:1.text: People keep saying the undead were warriors, but I don't buy it. One of them tried to tear me apart once!
say:2:1330369001:1.source_cn: 都说活死人就是从前的战士，我不信，他们之前还攻击过我。
say:2:1330369001:1.male: People keep saying the undead were warriors, but I don't buy it. One of them tried to tear me apart once!
say:2:1330369001:1.female: People keep saying the undead were warriors, but I don't buy it. One of them tried to tear me apart once!

say:3:1330369002:1.text: That's what you get for poking around the ancient battlefield just to prove a point.
say:3:1330369002:1.source_cn: 那是因为你非要去古战场看他们是不是真的是战士。
say:3:1330369002:1.male: That's what you get for poking around the ancient battlefield just to prove a point.
say:3:1330369002:1.female: That's what you get for poking around the ancient battlefield just to prove a point.

say:4:1330369003:1.text: They don't have memories anymore. They probably thought you were some Hypogean. And if they mistake you for a threat, you can guess what'll happen next.
say:4:1330369003:1.source_cn: 战士们已经失去意识了，保不齐把你认成了恶魔，不打你打谁。
say:4:1330369003:1.male: They don't have memories anymore. They probably thought you were some Hypogean. And if they mistake you for a threat, you can guess what'll happen next.
say:4:1330369003:1.female: They don't have memories anymore. They probably thought you were some Hypogean. And if they mistake you for a threat, you can guess what'll happen next.

say:5:1330369004:1.text: All I'm saying is don't pull that kind of reckless stunt again.
say:5:1330369004:1.source_cn: 总之不提倡你这种作死行为。
say:5:1330369004:1.male: All I'm saying is don't pull that kind of reckless stunt again.
say:5:1330369004:1.female: All I'm saying is don't pull that kind of reckless stunt again.
